title: This 5 mm Spider Dances for His Life or Gets Eaten

scenes.text: This spider has to dance or get eaten.
It's a peacock spider, under five millimeters long, and the male unfolds a flap of brilliant color.
He raises his legs, waves them, struts toward the female, and shakes the ground with abdomen vibrations.
Researchers filmed sixty-four pairs. Females liked only sixteen of the dances.
And when a female isn't impressed, she may attack and eat him.
In the study, his looks mattered about twice as much as his moves. He needs both.

description:
A male peacock spider, under 5 millimeters long, dances to impress a female.
If she is not impressed, she may attack and eat him.
Would you dance for your life?
first_comment: Best dancer in the animal kingdom? Tell us below.
